clue.text: High explosive about a quarter is made from canvas

indicators.note: about means the explosive's letters go round the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: TNT is the familiar high explosive
E, east, is one of the four quarters of the compass

explanation.surface: A demolition charge set somewhere around a canvas structure.
explanation.walkthrough: A compass point is 'a quarter' in crosswords; E sits inside TNT. 'Under canvas' means camping, so canvas can stand for the shelter itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Canvas is used by metonymy for a camping shelter, as in the idiom sleeping under canvas.

clue.text: Revolver allowing gateman to ensure orderly entrance

definitions.meaning: something that revolves, here a rotating barrier, not a gun

definitions.text: allowing gateman to ensure orderly entrance
definitions.meaning: a turning gate letting people through one at a time at a stadium or station

explanation.surface: A gatekeeper with a gun keeps the queue in order.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotating barrier with arms admits one person per turn, which literally revolves.

clue.text: Dismiss sentries? On the contrary, give them a job

definitions.text: Dismiss sentries? On the contrary, give them a job

parts.words: Dismiss sentries? On the contrary, give them a job
parts.note: the phrase looks as if it means expelling the watchmen, but the military order calls them out to parade or duty

explanation.surface: An officer seems to sack the sentries but actually puts them to work.
explanation.definitionFit: The military command summons the sentry detail to parade, the opposite of sending them away.

clue.text: Do members of this society conform to the laws of motion?

definitions.text: Do members of this society conform to the laws of motion?

parts.words: Do members of this society conform to the laws of motion?
parts.note: laws of motion suggests Newtonian physics, but a motion is a proposal argued over in a formal society

explanation.surface: A physics question about whether club members obey Newton.
explanation.definitionFit: A society where members argue formal motions is a club devoted to argument.

clue.text: Sweet coffee served after it

definitions.meaning: a British word for a pudding course
the course that comes just before the coffee at a dinner

explanation.surface: A sugary coffee arrives at the end of a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweet is the British name for the pudding course, which precedes coffee at the end of dinner.

clue.text: See 19 across
Am following the PM !

parts.note: reads like a loyal follower of the Prime Minister, but am and pm are the halves of the day

explanation.surface: Someone declares loyalty to the Prime Minister.
explanation.definitionFit: The first hours after midnight come straight after this evening, being the a.m. that follows the p.m.

clue.text: A desire for too much vice

definitions.meaning: an excessive wanting of more than one needs
one of the seven deadly sins, avarice

explanation.surface: Wanting too much is a moral failing.
explanation.definitionFit: Avarice is the excessive desire for wealth and one of the seven deadly sins.

clue.text: Censures one who establishes the facts again ?

definitions.meaning: rebukes or scolds

definitions.text: one who establishes the facts again ?
definitions.meaning: read as ..., demonstrating something a second time

explanation.surface: A critic who rechecks the facts and then scolds.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebuke someone is to censure them; split as re-proves it means demonstrates again.

clue.text: Put a price on excellence

definitions.meaning: to assess what something is worth
worth or merit

explanation.surface: Appraising quality.
explanation.definitionFit: To appraise is to fix a worth; as a noun it means merit or worthiness.

clue.text: A sudden drop in one's standing!

definitions.text: A sudden drop in one's standing!

parts.words: A sudden drop in one's standing!
parts.note: sounds like a fall in social status, but literally a fall from being on one's feet

explanation.surface: A loss of reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: A fall from an upright position is a sudden drop from standing.

clue.text: For people to read after unwinding

definitions.text: For people to read after unwinding

parts.words: For people to read after unwinding
parts.note: unwinding suggests relaxing, but here it is the unrolling of a roll of parchment

explanation.surface: A relaxing book for the evening.
explanation.definitionFit: An ancient rolled document has to be unrolled before it can be read.

clue.text: Made "Big Shot " from original film " In Camera"

definitions.text: Made "Big Shot " from original film " In Camera"

parts.words: Made "Big Shot " from original film " In Camera"
parts.note: looks like film titles, but describes a photograph blown up from its negative

explanation.surface: A studio remakes one movie from another.
explanation.definitionFit: A photographic print blown up from the negative has been made bigger, a big shot.

clue.text: Its literal translation is missing, but it means: use badly

indicators.note: translation means the letters of the words are turned into a new arrangement
missing means the letters of the little word is must be left out of the pool

explanation.surface: A complaint that a literal rendering has been lost, misusing the text.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translation' rearranges ITS LITERAL, and 'is missing' tells you to take out the letters I and S, leaving eight letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: To mistreat someone is to handle them cruelly or badly.

clue.text: Be obstructive-don't go to bed

definitions.meaning: to block, as a drain may be blocked
British informal for staying awake late

explanation.surface: Being awkward by refusing to go to bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To block an opening is to plug it; in British usage it also means to stay awake late.

clue.text: A case before a particular hearing may influence the decision

definitions.text: A case before a particular hearing may influence the decision

parts.words: A case before a particular hearing may influence the decision
parts.note: a legal case decided earlier that guides judges in a later trial

explanation.surface: A court matter that may sway the verdict.
explanation.definitionFit: An earlier ruling cited in court to guide judges deciding a similar dispute.

clue.text: Puts design on metal or glass sheet, a hundred different ways

definitions.text: Puts design on metal or glass

indicators.note: the letters are arranged in a different way, signalling an anagram

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Engraving patterns on a glass sheet in a hundred styles.
explanation.definitionFit: Engraving by acid on metal or glass plates puts a design onto them.

clue.text: Beat a plague !

definitions.meaning: to whip or flog
a cause of widespread suffering

explanation.surface: Overcome an epidemic!
explanation.definitionFit: A whip used to flog people, and figuratively a great affliction or pest.

clue.text: Mrs B. E. Lee turned out to look like another

indicators.note: turned out suggests becoming, but signals the letters are turned into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Mrs B. E. Lee turned out to look like someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: To be similar in appearance to someone else is to look like another.

clue.text: Considers them to be messages of goodwill

definitions.meaning: judges or looks upon
good wishes sent to someone, as in send my best

explanation.surface: Thinking of greetings as kindly.
explanation.definitionFit: To look upon something as is to consider; the plural noun means kind wishes sent on.

clue.text: Likely to cut a piece of music!

definitions.meaning: keen-edged
a note raised by a semitone, a symbol in written music

explanation.surface: A cutting piece of music.
explanation.definitionFit: A keen-edged blade cuts; in music a semitone-raised note bears the same name.

clue.text: Down Hard-fought contests requiring ringcraft?

definitions.meaning: fierce, evenly matched fights
ringcraft is boxing skill, but the first part imitates a bell's ring

explanation.surface: Tough boxing matches that demand skill in the ring.
explanation.walkthrough: The stray 'Down' is the remnant of the printed cross-reference to the linked 4 down light.
explanation.definitionFit: Evenly matched fierce struggles are described as fights swinging to and fro like a bell.

clue.text: Underworld takes me in for American money

indicators.note: takes with in means the underworld swallows the other piece
in with takes means the second piece goes inside the first

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and his realm

explanation.surface: Hell takes me in for some American cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes ... in' is split around the second piece; Dis is the Roman underworld, both the god and his realm, a classical name solvers may not know.
explanation.definitionFit: Ten-cent coins are units of United States currency.

clue.text: Turn up a pair of kings to get 4E

parts.note: R, for rex, is the abbreviation for king, so two give RR
IV is four in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A card player turns up two kings.
explanation.walkthrough: The page reads '44', most likely a misread of '4E'; A, two Rs for kings, IV and E build the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To turn up is to appear or reach a place, an informal synonym.

clue.text: Expensive material for local medical officer has atmosphere

parts.note: MOH is the Medical Officer of Health, a British local-authority post

explanation.surface: A council doctor has an air of expensive cloth.
explanation.walkthrough: The Medical Officer of Health was the public-health doctor of a British local council, hence 'local'.
explanation.definitionFit: A luxurious fabric woven from Angora goat hair is a costly textile.

clue.text: Once produced, stopped convict going down

definitions.text: Once produced, stopped convict going down

parts.words: Once produced, stopped convict going down
parts.note: going down suggests being sent to prison or hanged; a stay of execution stops it once issued

explanation.surface: A document that halts a prisoner's descent.
explanation.definitionFit: A stay of execution or cancellation of punishment saves a condemned prisoner.

clue.text: Men war, but not a naval force

definitions.text: Men war, but not a naval force

parts.words: Men war, but not a naval force
parts.note: men of war are warships, but fighting men on land are not the navy

explanation.surface: Men at war, though not sailors.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue as held seems to have lost 'of': 'Men of war' are warships, so the cd says fighting men who are not a navy.
explanation.definitionFit: Army troops are fighting men who serve on land rather than at sea.

clue.text: Present day offering?

parts.note: present day suggests modern times, but present is a noun, a thing offered on a special day

explanation.surface: Something on offer nowadays.
explanation.definitionFit: A present given on a birthday is an offering given freely.
